title: System Monitor
summary: A live view of CPU, temperature, memory, storage, network and power.
description: Six tiles show the board or PC at a glance, each with a two-minute history; a tap opens a live chart and the details, with the top processes. The Power tile reports under-voltage and throttling on a Raspberry Pi (needs vcgencmd and the video group) and the battery on x86 PCs and tablets. Refreshes every 1, 2 or 5 seconds. Read-only: it changes nothing on the system. No special hardware.
